title: 第3章 炼体功法第4章 矿材失窃
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 外面，山脚的大树下，钱朵朵正爬在树上摘果子，陈功和林越坐在地上休息。
陈功倚着树，跷着腿，手里拿着啃了一口的果子，不经意地问道：“你们说李牧火那小子到底是精明还是真憨？五年啊！他每天要干我们四个人的活，就为了我们一个看不见的照拂？”
忽地，陈功猛地坐直了身子，惊呼道：“这小子该不会是想等三个月后毁约吧？到时候咱们根本不会打铁，打不出东西来，定然会被处罚，甚至逐出宗门。”
林越则平静地摇头道：“一个人喜欢什么是掩饰不住的，看得出来，他是真的喜欢打铁。至于你说的整我们，则完全没有道理。我们与他素不相识，他如此做除了给自己树敌外，没有任何好处。”
说罢，林越认真地看向陈功道：“你若怀疑，便不该应承。既然承了人家的情，便莫要在背后非议与揣测，此非君子行径。”
这时，就听树上传来钱朵朵的声音：“林越说得对，你要是怀疑，就不要应承。而且，他着实没必要骗我们。还有，就算我们不打铁，也不该坐享其成。既然他替我们打铁了，那劈柴烧火这些事，自然应该我们来做，这叫礼尚往来。”
“好啦！好啦！我就是这么一说……”
陈功脸上露出几分不耐烦的情绪。
半日后。
炼器房里，李牧火正满头大汗地挥着铁锤，嘴角总噙着一抹似有若无的微笑。
见钱朵朵三人抱着一堆果子回来，便笑着招呼道：“这么快就回来了？我再有一会儿就能把最后一把柴刀锻好了，你们坐着再等会儿。”
“辛苦了。”
林越又坐到了石台上，微微喘息着。
钱朵朵则忙追问道：“你今年多大啊？”
李牧火想了想道：“还有一个月就15了。”
只见钱朵朵的小脸顿时垮了下来，陈功则是哈哈大笑起来。
“怎么了？”
李牧火疑惑地看着两人。
钱朵朵嘟着嘴巴，小声嘟囔着说道：“我们决定以年龄高低排列辈分，你第三，我最末。”
陈功则笑道：“她还抱着一丝希望，觉得她可能比你年纪大，也不想想你这么大的块头，怎么可能比她年纪小。”
李牧火虽然15岁不到，但身高已经高达一米七五，身材宽阔，孔武有力，在这个年纪来说，确实算得上是大块头。
不过这并不是天生的，而是他把精粹加在了体魄上，硬生生给提上来的。
“那谁最大？”
陈功顿时悻悻然：“林越那家伙略大我几天。”
李牧火则忽然放下手里的铁锤，双手微拱，很认真地对林越和陈功分别见礼。
“见过四师兄。”
“见过五师兄。”
因为坊里本就有大师兄秦力，二师兄杨开山和一个尚未见面的三师兄，所以林越和陈功只能排在第四和第五。
林越也没想到李牧火如此郑重，当即也起身还礼，同样认真道：“六师弟。”
陈功则尴尬地挠头道：“你们这也，太较真吧？”
林越则看着他道：“这叫礼。师弟有礼，作为师兄，我们岂能无礼？”
钱朵朵见状，当即眼珠子一转，对着三人分别行了一礼道：“见过四师兄，五师兄，六师兄。今天咱们算是正式见过了，以后可是天天见的，不能每次都这样吧？”
content_en:
Outside, under the big tree at the foot of the mountain, Qian Duoduo was climbing on the tree to pick fruits, while Chen Gong and Lin Yue were sitting on the ground to rest.
Chen Gong leaned against the tree, crossed his legs, took a bite of the fruit in his hand, and asked casually: "Do you think that boy Li Muhuo is smart or really stupid? Five years! He has to do the work of the four of us every day, just for us to look after him invisible?"
Suddenly, Chen Gong sat up straight and exclaimed: "Does this guy want to wait three months to break the contract? By then, we won't be able to forge anything at all, and we will definitely be punished or even expelled from the sect."
Lin Yue shook his head calmly and said: "You can't hide what a person likes. It can be seen that he really likes blacksmithing. As for what you said about teasing us, it makes no sense at all. We are strangers to him, and his doing this will not do any good except making enemies for himself."
After saying that, Lin Yue looked at Chen Gong seriously and said: "If you have doubts, you should not agree. Since you have accepted someone's love, don't criticize and speculate behind his back. This is not the behavior of a gentleman."
At this time, Qian Duoduo's voice was heard from the tree: "Lin Yue is right, if you have doubts, don't agree. Moreover, there is really no need for him to lie to us. Also, even if we don't forge iron, we shouldn't just sit back and enjoy the gains. Since he has forged iron for us, we should naturally do things like chopping wood and lighting fires. This is called reciprocity."
"Okay! Okay! That's what I said..."
Chen Gong's face showed a bit of impatience.
Half a day later.
In the refining room, Li Muhuo was sweating profusely while swinging the hammer, with a faint smile on his face.
Seeing Qian Duoduo and the others coming back with a bunch of fruits, they greeted with a smile: "Come back so soon? I will be able to forge the last hatchet in a while. You guys sit down and wait a while."
"Thank you for your hard work."
Lin Yue sat on the stone platform again, panting slightly.
Qian Duoduo hurriedly asked: "How old are you this year?"
Li Muhuo thought for a moment and said, "It will be 15 in one month."
Qian Duoduo's little face suddenly fell down, and Chen Gong burst into laughter.
"What's wrong?"
Li Muhuo looked at the two of them doubtfully.
Qian Duoduo pouted and muttered in a low voice: "We decided to rank the seniority according to age. You are third and I am last."
Chen Gongze smiled and said: "She still holds on to a glimmer of hope, thinking that she may be older than you, and she doesn't think about how you can be younger than her with such a big body."
Although Li Muhuo is less than 15 years old, he is already 1.75 meters tall, has a broad build and is powerful. He is indeed considered a big guy at this age.
But this is not something he is born with, but something he adds to his physique and forcibly brings it up.
"Then who's the biggest?"
Chen Gong suddenly said angrily: "That guy Lin Yue is a few days older than me."
Li Muhuo suddenly put down the hammer in his hand, arched his hands slightly, and greeted Lin Yue and Chen Gong seriously.
"I've met Fourth Senior Brother."
"I've met Fifth Senior Brother."
Because there are senior brother Qin Li, second senior brother Yang Kaishan and a third senior brother who have not yet met in the workshop, Lin Yue and Chen Gong can only be ranked fourth and fifth.
Lin Yue did not expect Li Muhuo to be so solemn, so he immediately stood up and returned the salute, saying equally seriously: "Sixth Junior Brother."
Chen Gongze scratched his head in embarrassment and said, "Aren't you guys too serious?"
Lin Yue looked at him and said, "This is called etiquette. Junior brothers are polite. As senior brothers, how can we be rude?"
When Qian Duoduo saw this, he immediately rolled his eyes and bowed to the three of them respectively: "I have met the fourth senior brother, the fifth senior brother, and the sixth senior brother. Today we have officially met, but we will see each other every day in the future. We can't do this every time, right?"
